claims: Over 1.3 million people have unclaimed 2022 federal tax refunds.
Unclaimed 2022 federal tax refunds total approximately $1.2 billion.
The median unclaimed 2022 federal tax refund is $686.
Taxpayers have until April 15, 2025, to file their 2022 Form 1040 to claim unclaimed 2022 federal tax refunds.
Unclaimed 2022 federal tax refunds become the property of the U.S. Treasury after April 15, 2025.
The law requires a 3-year window to file and claim refunds.
Federal tax refunds can be used to pay off outstanding federal or state debts such as child support or student loans.
There is generally no penalty for failing to file if a refund is due.
